expanded_sensitivity_analysis.control_rule: Twenty nearest same-predictor controls using nuclear-coordinate, separation-energy and drip-class distance.

primary_interpretation: The original V10.1 narrow matching rule identifies candidate-level mass-surface anomalies for a subset of externally annotated halo nuclei. The magnitude and direction of those effects are sensitive to control-pool construction and do not establish universal or direct spatial halo discrimination.
scientific_boundary: This release evaluates local binding-energy mass-surface behaviour. It does not directly use matter radii, charge radii, reaction cross sections or spectroscopic observables.

strict_v10_1_replication.control_rule: Up to three nearest non-halo controls from the same mass region and 1000 keV drip class.
